execution_truth: One machine cognition applied the 3D Game Asset Specialist body to one real AXM asset. This is not evidence of an independent specialist intelligence or general professional competence.

runtime_attempts.basis: Profession Fabric's repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN received Repository not found while attempting to fetch the separate private Wreckline repository at the pinned commit. The Godot/import steps were therefore skipped.
runtime_attempts.repair: The evidence workflow now retains this state as a successful blocked-source receipt when no scoped cross-repository read token exists, and only runs the Godot observer when WRECKLINE_READ_TOKEN is available.

gates.basis: Pinned repository, PR, source head, candidate path and exact LOD0 SHA are retained.

Retained Wreckline receipts cover generated geometry, UV/tangent state, materials/textures, LODs, separate collision, hardpoints, module contracts, semantic bindings and static visual evidence, but not target-host interpretation.

The first bounded Godot proof-host attempt never received candidate bytes because the Profession Fabric Actions token is repository-scoped and Wreckline is private. This is not evidence for or against engine compatibility.
The Wreckline asset receipt explicitly records continuous_playback_verified=false; sampled poses are not continuous observation, and the proof-host attempt did not reach the asset.
Module contracts and empty sockets exist, but no retained native/runtime mounted-module transition has been observed. The proof-host attempt did not reach the asset.
Static software views exist, but representative road/chase-camera runtime observation is still open.
No completed target runtime/hardware performance contract is retained for certification.

positive_profession_evidence: The profession preserves exact candidate identity instead of treating a later regeneration as equivalent evidence.
The profession separates structural, visual, runtime, animation, modularity and performance surfaces instead of collapsing them into one game-ready label.
The profession treats missing target/runtime evidence as HOLD/NOT_TESTED rather than inventing acceptance.
The profession correctly classifies a private-source checkout failure as an access block rather than an asset or engine failure.
The profession identifies the smallest meaningful continuation as observation/integration rather than more modeling.

Representative chase-camera/road-context observation including LOD behavior.
Relevant target performance measurement if a performance claim is requested.

truth_boundary: This task is real evidence that the experimental body can preserve source identity, classify existing evidence, distinguish an access failure from a runtime failure, identify missing runtime proof and abstain from promotion on one substantial modular vehicle. It is not target-runtime acceptance, broad competence proof, cross-intelligence validation or permission to call the asset game-ready.
